item.title: Grand Rapids approves $14.56M contract with company for river restoration project
item.description: Grand Rapids has agreed to a $14.5 million construction contract with a Kalamazoo-based company for the project to restore the rapids to the Grand River and reshape the riverfront.

item.title: Rep. Al Green escorted out of chamber as Trump begins State of the Union

item.title: Chief says GRPD will not release more video of deadly shooting
item.description: Meeting Tuesday for the first time since a man was shot and killed by an officer last week, the Grand Rapids Public Safety Committee asked the police chief when additional video may be released.

item.title: Man, 82, killed in crash north of Grand Rapids
item.description: An 82-year-old man died after a crash north of Grand Rapids Tuesday afternoon, police say.

item.title: Trump says US hockey goaltender will get Presidential Medal of Freedom
item.description: President Trump announced at the State of the Union address Tuesday that he would give the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Team USA hockey goaltender Connor Hellebuyck after he recorded 41 saves in the gold medal game against Canada. item.title: Longtime West Michigan radio host dies
item.description: One of the longtime voices of West Michigan has died. 93.7 B-93 program director Dave Taft announced in a social media post that former host Reese Rickards died Tuesday.

item.title: Teen shot, injured in Muskegon Heights, police say
item.description: A teenager was taken to the hospital after he was shot in Muskegon Heights Tuesday night, police say.

item.title: ICE detainee's $50K bond paid by East Grand Rapids woman
item.description: A stranger helped a documented immigrant detained by ICE in Northern Michigan post bond so he could reunite with family.

item.title: Human remains found near US-131 in Plainfield Township, police say
item.description: “Significantly decomposed” human remains were found in Plainfield Township Tuesday night, police say.
